text.tspan: Annual Report of the Great Lakes Regional Water Use Database Representing 2023 Water Use Data
Ohio’s net total diversion amount was 25 mgd (96 mld) into the Lake Erie watershed.
the Lake Erie watershed totaled 11 mgd (43 mld), all for public water supply purpose. They were offset by
37 mgd (138 mld) of incoming diversions, primarily associated with the other self-supply sector (26 mgd
or 100 mld), and diversion returns. An additional small incoming diversion was reported for the self-supply
livestock (0.2 mgd or 0.8 mld) sector. Consumptive use in Ohio totaled 125 mgd (473 mld) in 2023, with
. Ohio consumptive use by sector over the past five years
Incoming diversions are reported as negative values in the database and on tables.
